Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the data and adopted an incorrect criterion. Despite sources clearly indicating Heroes of the Street (1922), the Planner introduced a spurious 1992 date and proposed using the “most recent widely-published commercial release” instead of the original release to decide which came out earlier. This compounded error (misreading the year and using an inappropriate rule) led away from the correct conclusion that Heroes of the Street (1922) predates Aanaval Mothiram (1990/1991).
